metadata.description: Ten Agent Skills from fifteen years of performance marketing and the systems built around it. Zero dependencies, offline, tested.

plugins.name: invisible-text-forensics
plugins.description: Find and remove invisible Unicode: zero-width characters, AI watermarks, bidi overrides, tag-character prompt injection, homoglyphs. The byte layer every humanizer skill misses.

plugins.name: cpa-profit-ops
plugins.description: Profit and ROI by country, campaign, account and operator computed from real payouts. Ad account triage and break-even CPL. What platform dashboards cannot tell you.

plugins.name: affiliate-tracker-ops
plugins.description: Find where the click id dies between ad, lander, offer and postback. Postback validation and verified traffic-source macros. Zeustrack, Voluum, Binom, Keitaro.

plugins.name: whatsapp-receptionist-builder
plugins.description: Build an AI receptionist on the WhatsApp Cloud API: signature over the raw body, the 24-hour service window, idempotency against retries, double-booking prevention.

plugins.name: lead-delivery-reconciliation
plugins.description: Normalise and deduplicate leads before delivery, then reconcile the buyer's register to get acceptance rate and effective payout per delivered lead.

plugins.name: competitor-ad-intelligence
plugins.description: Rank competitor creatives without spend data: longevity, variants, geo spread, velocity, recency. Lineage grouping so re-uploads do not fake short lifespans.

plugins.name: incrementality-testing
plugins.description: Sample ratio mismatch, an always-valid sequential test that survives daily peeking, CUPED variance reduction, and geo designs for channels with no user randomisation.

plugins.name: ad-comment-moderation
plugins.description: A rule engine for comments under Facebook and Instagram ads that states a reason for every verdict, keeps honest criticism visible, and finds dark post threads.

plugins.name: bank-statement-to-table
plugins.description: Convert a bank statement PDF into a spreadsheet, then prove the extraction against the statement's own running balance. Entirely offline.

plugins.name: always-on-agent
plugins.description: Build a personal agent that runs on your own machine: four layers, waking a laptop that sleeps, approval gates, and a first pass that never reads a secret's value.
